subject: ela
intro: Students describe characters (how they look, feel, and act), settings (where and when a story takes place), and major events using key details from the text. This skill builds the ability to visualize stories and understand how character traits drive plot.

items.prompt:
Read the story below.

Aisha was very brave. When her little brother was scared of the thunder, she held his hand. She told him, 'I am here. It will be okay.'

Describe Aisha. Use details from the story.

steps: I look for words that tell about Aisha.
The story says she is 'very brave.'
Her actions show this too: she held her brother's hand and comforted him.
I use both the description and her actions to describe her.
solution.answer: Aisha is brave and caring. The story tells us she is brave, and her actions show she cares for her brother by holding his hand and telling him it will be okay.

items.prompt:
Read the story below.

The boys played in a snowy park. The trees were bare and the air was cold. They built a snowman near the big oak tree.

Describe the setting of this story.

steps: I ask: where and when does this story take place?
The story says it is a park in the snow. The trees are bare and the air is cold.
Snow and cold and bare trees all suggest winter.
The setting is a cold, snowy park in winter.
solution.answer: The setting is a snowy park in winter. It is cold outside, the trees are bare, and there is a big oak tree nearby.

items.prompt:
Read the story below.

Sam tripped and fell in front of the whole class. His face turned red. He wanted to run away. But he got up, dusted himself off, and kept going.

Describe how Sam felt. Use two details from the story.

steps: I look for feelings in the story.
His face turned red means he felt embarrassed.
He wanted to run away, which also shows embarrassment.
But getting up and going on shows he was also brave.
I use both feelings in my answer.
solution.answer: Sam felt embarrassed when he fell. His red face and wanting to run away both show this. But he was also brave because he got up and kept going instead of hiding.

items.prompt:
Read the story below.

Marco saw a big dog blocking the path. The dog barked loud. Marco stopped. He held very still. Then the dog wagged its tail and walked away.

Describe the major event in this story.

steps: I ask: what is the most important thing that happens in this story?
A big dog blocked Marco's path and barked.
Marco stayed still, and the dog wagged its tail and left.
This is the main event because it is what the whole story is about.
solution.answer: The major event is that Marco came across a big barking dog blocking his path. He stayed very still, and the dog ended up wagging its tail and walking away.

items.prompt:
Read the story below.

Leo was a shy boy. He never raised his hand in class. One day, he knew the answer and slowly put his hand up. His teacher smiled and called on him. He got it right.

How does Leo change in this story? Describe him at the beginning and at the end.

steps: At the beginning, Leo is shy and never raises his hand.
At the end, he slowly puts his hand up and gets the answer right.
He goes from being too shy to act, to taking a brave step.
His character changes from very shy to a little bit braver.
solution.answer: At the beginning, Leo is described as shy and never raises his hand. At the end, he takes a risk and raises his hand for the first time. He changes from a boy who holds back to one who is willing to try.

items.prompt:
Read the story below.

Zoe was very funny. She always made her friends laugh at lunch. She could do silly voices and tell jokes. Everyone wanted to sit next to Zoe.

Describe Zoe using details from the story.
items.hint: Look for words that describe Zoe and clues from her actions.

steps: The story says she is 'very funny.'
She makes friends laugh, does silly voices, and tells jokes.
Everyone wants to sit next to her, which shows she is popular and well-liked.
solution.answer: Zoe is funny and popular. She makes her friends laugh with silly voices and jokes. Everyone wants to sit next to her because she is so entertaining and fun to be around.

items.prompt:
Read the story below.

Ben sat in his backyard at night. Stars filled the dark sky. Fireflies blinked in the tall grass. It was warm and quiet.

Describe the setting of this story.
items.hint: Think about where the story is and what time of day and season it might be.

steps: The place is Ben's backyard.
It is nighttime because of the dark sky and stars.
Fireflies suggest summer.
It is warm and quiet.
solution.answer: The setting is a backyard on a warm summer night. The sky is dark with stars, fireflies blink in the grass, and everything is quiet.

items.prompt:
Read the story below.

Maya wanted to ride her bike without training wheels. She tried and fell. She tried again and wobbled but stayed up. By the third try, she rode down the whole street.

Describe Maya using key details about her feelings and actions.
items.hint: Look at what Maya does each time she tries. What does that tell you about her?

steps: Maya fell but kept trying.
She did not give up after falling.
By the third try she succeeded.
She is determined and persistent.
solution.answer: Maya is determined and does not give up easily. She fell, wobbled, and tried three times before she rode down the whole street. Her actions show she is brave and keeps going even when things are hard.

items.prompt:
Read the story below.

Sam's class had a visitor. A woman in a bright red coat walked in. She carried a big box. Her eyes were warm and kind. She smiled at everyone.

Describe the visitor. What details does the author use?
items.hint: Look for details about how she looks and how she acts.

steps: She wears a bright red coat.
She carries a big box.
Her eyes are warm and kind.
She smiles at everyone.
solution.answer: The visitor is a woman in a bright red coat who carries a big box. She has warm, kind eyes and smiles at everyone. These details make her seem friendly and welcoming.

items.prompt:
Read the story below.

Aisha and Leo were both trying to win the school art contest. They stayed late every day to finish their paintings. On the last day, they both turned in their work. When the winner was announced, it was a tie.

Describe the major event in this story.
items.hint: Think about what the whole story builds up to.

steps: The story builds up to the contest results.
Both students worked hard.
The major event is the announcement of the winner.
Both students tied, which is the surprise ending.
solution.answer: The major event is the announcement of the art contest winner. Both Aisha and Leo worked very hard, staying late each day. When the winner was announced, it was a tie between them, which was a surprising and happy ending.
